candidates.name: LIDAR Composite Digital Terrain Model (DTM) 10m
verified_facts: The 10m DTM is resampled from the 2m LIDAR Composite DTM using bilinear interpolation.
It inherits the composite survey lineage rather than representing a new higher-accuracy acquisition.
semantic_limits: A 10m resampled grid is not an accuracy upgrade and should not replace finer source terrain data for parcel-scale relief when finer validated data exists.

candidates.name: LIDAR Composite Digital Surface Model (DSM) - 1m
verified_facts: The 1m composite DSM includes buildings, vegetation, vehicles and terrain and is built from Time Stamped and National LIDAR Programme surveys.
Repeat surveys use newest best-resolution data and resampled inputs may use bilinear interpolation.
semantic_limits: DSM object-inclusive elevations remain unsuitable as default bare-earth parcel terrain measurements regardless of 1m grid resolution.
